# tests/fixtures/real_floorplans/README.md

# Real Floor Plan Fixtures

## Important Note

Attempts were made to download freely-licensed floor plan photographs from
Wikimedia Commons. Both download attempts failed due to Wikimedia's anti-bot
rate-limiting on thumbnail URLs.

**The two images in this directory are synthetically generated using Pillow.**
They are clean black-line-on-white-background floor plan diagrams, not real
architectural photographs.

## Why this matters

The segmentation model (`Yytsi/floorplan-to-3d-walls`) was trained on the
CubiCasa5K dataset, which contains **SVG-rasterized architectural drawings**
— clean, white-background, black-line floor plans very similar to our
synthetic test images.  This means our synthetic images are actually a
*reasonable proxy* for the training distribution: they share the same visual
style (high-contrast lines, white fill, no textures, no photographs).

They are **not** the same as real-world floor plan photos or hand-drawn
sketches, which the model may perform worse on.

## Fixture descriptions

| File | Content | Approximate room count |
|------|---------|----------------------|
| `sample_fp_1.png` | 3-room L-shaped residential plan (512×512 px) | 3 |
| `sample_fp_2.png` | 5-room apartment-style plan (640×480 px) | 5 |

Both images were generated by `tests/fixtures/real_floorplans/generate_samples.py`.

## To replace with genuine samples

Download any freely-licensed architectural floor plan drawing from:
- [Wikimedia Commons: Floor plans](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Floor_plans)
  — look for SVG or high-resolution PNG files, license CC0 or CC-BY.
- [CubiCasa5K dataset](https://github.com/CubiCasa/CubiCasa5k) — the model's
  original training data; any `model.svg` file rendered to PNG would be ideal.

Place them in this directory and update this README with source + license info.
